name: Python 3 (Streamlit + FastAPI)
updateContentCommand: [ -f packages.txt ] && sudo apt update && sudo xargs -r apt install -y < packages.txt; python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install --upgrade pip && if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; else pip install streamlit; fi; echo '✅ Env ready'
